steps.name: Panicked Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: What's going on?! Who are these people...?

steps.name: Panicked Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: It's... it's Reunion! Why are they attacking us?!

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: H-Huh...? What is going on—

steps.name: Panicked Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: What... What are you people doing?

steps.name: Panicked Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Stop it! This is our neighborhood!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Gah, scram if you don't want trouble!

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Ughh—!

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: You... You can't do this...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why not? You know what kind of a rotten life you've got in this pathetic place.
Stop it—

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: I know that voice... It's her...!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I made it... *pant*...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Please don't hurt them. They are innocent!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You've already razed a few blocks' worth of streets and shops. There are the homes of innocent civilians... How are they supposed to get by now?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who cares?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Like I give a crap how they live. Now scram, or you're next!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not going to back down. I've spent my life bringing happiness... to encourage people to stay positive and live on.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's why... if you're going to destroy their lives... I will protect them. I am more than capable.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Besides, I've got help.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Stop bluffi—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Whistles)

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who's there...?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sorry we kept ya waitin', Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Croissant, Exusiai, and... Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I don't think they're all that discouraged by anything you just said.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: In that case, it's time that we, Penguin Logistics, allies of justice, show you what for! Boink! Kapow! We'll knock you all down, just like that!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: 'Penguin Logistics?' Heh, you really think you can stop us?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's an emergency, so we've got no time to check with the boss, but he's not one to just stand aside while a bunch of bad guys muck up our turf! This is where we do business, after all!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Watch out. We don't know what these men might do. I'll stall them here and put a stop to it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay, Exusiai and I will take them out. Croissant, help evacuate the residents.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: On it, yeehaw!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: First, let's secure the path east...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Heyah—

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: W-Why can't... I... move?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hmph, take this—

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: *cough*... It's the singing girl's Arts... Stop her song. Take her out first!

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Did they... stop?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heh... Trying to ambush us? Let's kick this into Overloading Mode, then!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Now. Run.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Running away? Not so fast... Let's try... this—!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Impossible... Not even my Arts are working...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Heheh, that's not all that Sora can do! Sora, rouse me up!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay... on it!

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Miss Sora... Is it really you? But... Why are you here...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Now! Get 'em—

steps.name: Panicked Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: Just who are you people...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Get clear first!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: There ain't time to think 'bout all that... Giddy up! Get movin'!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Huh? That girl over there...)

steps.name: Trapped Lungmen Citizen
steps.text: (Ugh... I can't. I can't let anybody see me like this...!)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Texas, the L.G.D.'s gonna be here mighty soon!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright. Exusiai, Sora—

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes, I got it...!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Time to split! Buh-bye!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That girl...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I think I've seen her before... No, I've definitely met her before.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Is that her...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She was at the front of the line to hand me a letter at my first fan meeting in Lungmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then, after one last letter, she stopped coming to my events...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm sure of it. She's my very first fan, after all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But... what is she doing here in the slums?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And... those Originium crystals on her arm...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did she... become an Infected?
A few days later
Penguin Logistics Office

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ahh... I'm pooped.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh, Sora? I didn't know you were here.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, Exusiai, Croissant. Yeah, I'm done with practice for the day.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's good. We're about to head out. You wanna come with us?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We gave the L.G.D. a hand the other day, and apparently they gave Boss a call, asking us to stop by their office to get a 'Lungmen Benevolent Organization' certificate.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: After we've done a photoshoot in front of L.G.D. HQ, let's see if anybody dares pull me over~

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: If'n yer drivin', yeah, you'll get pulled over. With them pitchers, though, I reckon ain't nobody gonna come checkin' my business licenses no more...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If you ask me, I think your little side business deserves to be inspected.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Heh, just makin' a quick buck.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So what'cha doin', Sora? Hmm... This a letter?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, it's... a letter from a fan.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Boy, that brings me back. When ya first got here, there was always all kindsa presents pilin' up in front of Penguin Logistics. Mailboxes stuffed to burstin' with fan mail.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Haha... Why don't you two go on ahead? I'll wait for Texas.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sounds good. Here's the key. I'm hitching a ride with Croissant~

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Don't worry yer li'l wings, Exusiai. I'll get'cha there safe n' sound n' right on time!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Don't be late, Sora! We don't get to be stand-up, model citizens every day!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, I won't.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (This should be the one...)

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (The handwriting... I remember it very well.)

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (She was there at my fan meeting... My very first fan...)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oh... Have you been waiting for me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hm? Oh, sorry, Texas. I spaced out.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did something happen...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, don't worry... It's not a big deal...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas... Were the people we helped in the slums the other day... all Infected?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's what's on your mind?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Was there somebody you knew?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not sure... but I think there was a girl... who I might've met once... probably.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: If that was really her, then she'd only be there because she was Infected. She wasn't... someone who lived there.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Did you see the letters?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Letters? What letters?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They came with the notice from L.G.D. this morning. Apparently they're letters of appreciation from the residents we saved.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Those letters are the reason the government is giving us that certificate.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Isn't that what you're reading right now?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, no... This is... a fan letter from before.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: A fan letter? You're reading it now, of all times...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Uh... Don't worry about it...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It really is nothing, Texas. I suddenly felt like it. That's all...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you coming with me to the L.G.D.? I'll drive.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mmhm. I'll go!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Get in the car then.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas... If... Just if. If a Lungmenite becomes infected, what options do they have?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I can only think of two.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They either have to leave Lungmen or go to the slums.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right... There's no other way... I know that.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: In the future... will I be allowed to go on deliveries alone? I don't want to be a bother... but I am a member of Penguin Logistics, and I want to help out like everybody else.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Can you protect yourself?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I... I can...!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Once you prove to me you can hold your own, I won't stop you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, thanks.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It kind of feels like I'm always thanking you...
A week later...
Lungmen, somewhere in the slums

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello, is anybody home? Your package is here!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Who is it...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello, the items you ordered on the Penguin Logistics website are here. Could you please sign for the package~?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: A package...? Leave it outside the door.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Umm... could you please sign for the package as well?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I... I'm not sure I can step outside...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh? Is everything okay? Do you need any help?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: No, that's not what I meant... I don't want to come outside... You... You're not infected, right? I have Oripathy... I could spread it to you...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I appreciate Penguin Logistics at least letting me place orders, but you could catch Oripathy from me. Please just go!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mister... Mister? Please, calm down.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We've got long, stable relationships with Infected clients. Oripathy isn't something you can catch from physical contact.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't worry. All Penguin Logistics staff have received Oripathy prevention training. You can't hurt me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And if you need any assistance, we can help you out anytime. We've partnered with a pharmaceutical company on several projects...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mister, are you okay?

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Are you... not afraid of me?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Of course not! Penguin Logistics aims to serve all customers with wholehearted devotion!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Never mind... Leave it at the door.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Right, can I count on you people to deliver a letter uptown for me next time?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Of course! Penguin Logistics offers mail delivery too!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Eh... fine. I need to let somebody there know how I'm doing. If they're willing to write back.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Um, Mister...? If you would like, I can help you get in touch...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: No, never mind. Just stay away from me. My brain is a mess right now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Let's leave it at that. I'll use you guys again next time.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It wasn't her...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I couldn't find her today either... Maybe she's already left Lungmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Maybe it never was her anyway...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But the handwriting in the appreciation letter to Penguin Logistics is the same as the fan letter I got.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She didn't leave an address or a name. It was just a simple thank you letter, but I know it. It was you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...I just... want to see you once again...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Are you willing to see me? Should... I even see you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: There is something I want to tell you face to face. I want to tell you that you've got to cheer up and find hope again.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Tomorrow... I'll come again tomorrow.
Two weeks later...
Lungmen slums, during a delivery

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello, is anybody home? Your package is here!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello, the items you ordered on the Penguin Logistics website are here. Could you please sign for the package~?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Is anybody home?
(Grits teeth)

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hm... this is the right delivery time...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hello? Is there really nobody home?
(Trembles)
...It's her voice.
But...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (It's the right place... Are they not home?)

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'll leave it at the door and send them a delivery confirmation... Okay.
Sora subconsciously places her hand on the edge of her pocket. Slowly, she takes out the letter.
On the old, tattered envelope are the words 'To Miss Sora.'
Sora has read the letter inside and compared it with the letter of appreciation countless times. Its contents have been etched into her soul—
Not only do the words of appreciation within evoke her nostalgia, they help keep her mind at ease.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: How come I can't find you? I saw you around here not too long ago... Have you really gone somewhere else?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I... want to see you again.
The person inside grips the door handle.
Yet the door does not open.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But it's no big deal... I know we'll meet again.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay, time for the next package... Where does this one go...?
She's gone... right?

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: (Bends over)

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: (Picks up the package)

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: Thank you... Miss Sora.

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: Looks like you got my letter.

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: I want to see you again too, but right now... my body... my disease...

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: You'll be happy once I finally find the courage to face myself again, right?

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: I... I'll come to your concerts again, and I will be there at your fan meetings.

steps.name: Slum Infected
steps.text: Someday.
